lines.t: (Verse 1)
Yeah, I wake up with a target on my back, so I call on Him,
No strength in this dust, every win that I got is Him.
Thoughts hit, I inspect it, is it flesh, is it seed from the pit,
If He flags it in the light, I reject it, let it fall, I don’t let it sit.
I see the trap in the scroll of the phone, in the feed, in the show, in the subtle tone,
Little looks turn hooks when you move on your own, that’s how lust plants roots ‘til a tree is grown.
So He teaches me to starve what the flesh keeps wanting,
Turn the plate down, let His Spirit do the hunting.
When my will feels strong, but my soul feels weak,
In the name of YahuShua that mountain speaks meek.
(Hook)
This that frontline, foxhole, midnight watch,
We’re small, He’s great, every gate on lock.
We don’t play with the dark, but His light gets dropped,
In the name of YahuShua every stronghold stops.
I said, this that blood‑bought, mercy‑driven warfare hymn,
Dust frame, weak heart, but His fire won’t dim.
We ain’t trusting in the flesh, we rely on Him,
Raise the banner, sound the trumpet, let His battle begin.
(Verse 2)
They tossing out doctrines that tickle the ear,
Cheap grace in the air, but His fear ain’t here.
I see shepherds in suits while the flock in chains,
Pretty pulpits, dead hearts, they don’t preach His reign.
But He opens up eyes, every lie gets vetted,
If it ain’t in His Word, then it don’t get credited.
We can’t stand on the culture, we too frail to lean,
So He breaks us from the world just to keep us clean.
I don’t trust every voice that can quote that page,
Cuz a serpent used scripture in the desert that day.
So I test every word by His flame, by His weight,
If the fruit ain’t His, then the root ain’t straight.
(Hook)
This that frontline, foxhole, midnight watch,
We’re small, He’s great, every gate on lock.
We don’t play with the dark, but His light gets dropped,
In the name of YahuShua every stronghold stops.
I said, this that blood‑bought, mercy‑driven warfare hymn,
Dust frame, weak heart, but His fire won’t dim.
We ain’t trusting in the flesh, we rely on Him,
Raise the banner, sound the trumpet, let His battle begin.
(Bridge – drill cadence)
Fast till the flesh get weak, let His Spirit get loud,
Drop knees to the floor, bring His fire in the cloud.
Can’t sleep on watch, can’t drink that cup,
Devil roam like a lion, but He lifts us up.
Guard mind, guard eyes, every click, every thought,
He supplies what we lack, we’re the ones He bought.
If the urge feel sweet but the end look grave,
By His power over sin we refuse that slave.
(Verse 3)
I seen saints fall off when they moved in pride,
Tried to lean on their grind, got swept by the tide.
That’s why I’m quick with the “Lord, keep my steps,”
If He don’t hold me up, I collapse in the test.
This world throw deals but the price too steep,
You can gain that clout, lose your soul in a week.
So I cling to His Word like a blade in my teeth,
When the war cry sound, it’s His sword I unsheath.
We the remnant, weak ones trained in the cave, unseen,
Hidden arrows in the quiver of the King, kept clean.
When He whistles for the squad, He gon’ break that scene,
Light shining in the smoke from the power of the King.
(Final Hook – extended)
This that trench‑mud, heartbeat, end‑times march,
Clay jars, but His glory be the only spark.
We don’t bow to the beast, we don’t kiss no ring,
We gon’ ride with the Lamb when the sky splits clean.
This that blood‑bought, mercy‑driven warfare hymn,
Dust frame, weak heart, but His fire won’t dim.
We ain’t trusting in the flesh, we rely on Him,
Raise the banner, sound the trumpet, let His battle begin.
